newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom has no comment on prices.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom has no comment on prices.

text.p: France Telecom confirmed on Thursday that it had been asked to make new proposals on so-called interconnection charges to regulator ART but had no comment on whether it had to cut proposed prices.
"We have been asked to submit a new proposal before the end of January," a France Telecom spokesman said. "We reserve the exclusivity of content of the proposal to the ART," he added.
Jean-Michel Hubert, president of the new Autorite de Regulation des Telecommunications (ART) regulator, said during the body's first news conference on Thursday that he had asked for a new proposal.

The catalogue of so-called interconnection charges is going to be a key element both for the economic viability of future entrants into the French market as well as for the value of France Telecom, slated for partial privatisation this spring in the biggest French market float ever.
